subject: koalas
one_liner: Cloud storage for your leaves, synced to every tree you have ever slept in. Uploads run during your waking hours, which is roughly two of them.
brand_voice_notes: A calm, well-funded storage company that has fully accepted its customers are asleep 20 hours a day. Treats a 4-month upload as a feature called Deep Sync. Never hurries. Refers to eucalyptus leaves as files, tree forks as devices, and joeys as shared users with read-only access because they cannot read. Australian place names, deadpan, no exclamation marks.

hero.sub: Gumdrive backs up every eucalyptus leaf you own to three gum trees in three different paddocks. Sync runs while you are awake, so most uploads finish by the following season.

features.title: Deep Sync
features.blurb: Files only move during your two waking hours a day. A single leaf of Manna Gum uploads in about eleven weeks. We have reframed this as rest.

features.title: Fork-to-fork backup
features.blurb: Every tree fork you sleep in is registered as a device. Wake up in a new tree and your leaves are already there, or they will be by March.

features.title: Pouch Sharing
features.blurb: Share a folder with the joey in your pouch. Permissions are read-only, since joeys cannot read. They can still chew the files, which we log.

demo_screen_concept: A Dropbox-style file browser called My Tree. Left sidebar lists registered forks (Manna Gum, north fork; Tallowwood, the good one; Swamp Mahogany, windy) plus a 24-hour sleep ring showing time until the next sync window. Main pane is a table of leaf files grouped by eucalyptus species, each row showing file name, size in leaves, toxicity rating, chew status, and a sync status chip that mostly reads 'Paused: owner asleep'. Species filter chips and a fake search box filter the table. Clicking a row opens a preview modal with leaf details and a 'Wake to sync' button that starts a progress bar crawling at 0.001% a second while a koala-voice toast apologises. A Share with joey toggle flips a row to read-only with a chew-risk warning.

design_direction.style: Soft UI Evolution, gum-mist daylight mode. A calm, expensive file-storage SaaS in soft layered surfaces: pale silver-green eucalyptus mist ground, cards lifted by gentle two-layer shadows, generous whitespace, and a serif display face that makes everything sound like a wellness retreat. Explicitly absent, because the last seven entries used them: 3px ink outlines, hard offset shadows, tennis seams, amount pills, masonry pins, iridescent gradients, crumb trails, lip buttons, lesson paths, bone meters, mascots, wall labels, empty plinths, clay stacks, silk threads, exuvia outlines, LCD greens, parts diagrams, rhumb lines, cartouches, wax seals. Also absent: dark backgrounds, glassmorphism, neon, monospace pixel type, paper textures. Four motifs carry the page. (1) The gum leaf corner: cards and buttons use an asymmetric 28px 6px 28px 6px radius, like a lanceolate eucalyptus leaf. (2) The sleep ring: a thin 24-hour ring, 20 hours shaded in mist, 2 hours in eucalyptus green, 2 hours unaccounted for, used in the hero, the pricing band and the demo sidebar. (3) The zzz chip: every sync status is a soft rounded chip with three small ascending z glyphs that drift upward slowly. (4) The gum blossom: red flowering-gum #B4472F is rationed to the primary CTA, the highlighted tier and the 'Wake to sync' button. Shadows: 0 1px 2px plus 0 12px 32px at 8% eucalyptus ink. Corners as above.
design_direction.archetype: Centered serif hero over a soft product photograph, then 3-up soft feature cards, a large product-UI preview card, testimonials with headshots, 3-tier pricing, footer.
design_direction.motion_vocab: Slow. Everything eases at 300ms with a long ease-out; zzz glyphs drift on a 6s loop; the sleep ring draws once on load. All drift disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
design_direction.hero_composition_notes: Left-aligned serif h1 and sub on the left half, a rounded leaf-corner photograph of a koala asleep in a gum fork on the right, with a floating soft card overlapping its lower edge reading a sync status: '1 leaf uploading. 11 weeks remaining.' plus the sleep ring.

images.rationale: Soft UI direction calls for a calm photographic hero, so 1 hero. Demo is a file-browser table (document-shaped), so no demo assets. Remaining 3 slots go to testimonial headshots for all three named users.
